# pangolin_organization (Data Source)

Look up an existing Pangolin organization by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_organization" "example" {
  org_id = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name of the organization.
- `subnet` (String) IPv4 CIDR block for the client subnet.
- `utility_subnet` (String) IPv4 CIDR block for the utility subnet.
